reason: B opens with a concrete, arresting object (the Brookes deck plan) and keeps handing the reader new specifics — Equiano's forty pounds, the Zong hearing, Potosi's mita, the Code Noir — so there is always a fresh scene or case rather than a continuing argument. A restates its single thesis (law converted labour demand into hereditary property) in paragraph after paragraph, and its resistance catalogue reads as a list of parallel summaries with little forward motion. B does repeat its state-versus-market claim, but it does so while advancing through capture, voyage, sale, credit, historiography, and abolition, giving a clearer sense of travel; A's short 1662 statute cannot carry a third of a chapter without visible restatement.
